newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT slips 2.56 pct in late session.
newsitem.headline: PLDT slips 2.56 pct in late session.

text.p: Telecommunications giant Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co dropped 20 pesos, or 2.56 percent, to 760 pesos in late trade on Wednesday as part of a selloff in blue chips, brokers said.
"This is a correction. The rise in blue chips was steep and since PLDT is a leading big-cap issue, it's among those being sold off," said Spencer Yap, analyst at BPI Securities Corp.
Brokers said the sharp $3 1/4 overnight rise in PLDT's American Depositary Receipts was ignored by the market.
On Tuesday, the phone company ended 47.5 pesos higher at 780 pesos. The ex-date of PLDT's 100 percent stock dividend was set Tuesday.
PLDT wasthe second most actively traded issue with 98.05 million pesos turnover.
